newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pearl Orient in HK$540 mln property acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Pearl Orient in HK$540 mln property acquisition.

text.p: Pearl Orient Holdings Ltd said on Monday it spent HK$540 million (US$69.9 million) acquiring a deluxe residence from the Heung Chit Kau family in Hong Kong's prestigious Peak area.
The property at 23 Severn Road is of a site area of 56,430 sq. feet and the house is of a gross floor area of 28,215 sq feet.
Pearl Orient said in a statement the Hong Kong government had approved a general building plan to redevelop the site into five detached houses each with an independent swimming pool.
The company has yet to decide whether to let out or redevelop the property, it said.
Heung was a renowed veteran in the securities and financial business in the territory during the 1970s and 1980s.
